title.rendered: Trial Decks Eternal Ascent Red・Green & Blue・Purple Preorders Now Available!

content.rendered:
Trial Decks Eternal Ascent Red・Green & Blue・Purple

📢 Introducing two trial decks for "Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME", inspired by the hit title "Palworld"!

Get ready to start your journey with Trial Decks Eternal Ascent Red・Green and Blue・Purple, releasing on December 18, 2026!

Included Contents:
・60 card set (Main Deck 50 Cards & Soul Deck 10 Cards)
・Paper Playmat & Play Guide
・Life Counter
・Material & Ingredient Counter

※Design and specifications are subject to change.

More details will be announced soon.
